metadata.source: Legacy prototype metadata cites Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS v4 / Copernicus); provenance and daily source series not supplied.
metadata.licence: Open-Meteo API data: CC BY 4.0; verify original data provenance before relying on stored thresholds.
metadata.history_period: Legacy prototype claim: 2016-01-01 to 2025-12-31; NOT independently verified.
metadata.winter_definition: 1 October to 31 March across 9 winters (2016/17 to 2024/25)
metadata.event_definition: A run of one or more consecutive days at or above the town's 99th percentile daily discharge (m3/s)
metadata.note: Do not run a legacy refresh routine. The historic percentiles and winter event counts are retained only for prototype reproducibility and must be recomputed from verified same-river daily records.
metadata.important_validation_note: GloFAS v4 reanalysis is documented through July 2022, so it cannot substantiate a complete 2016-2025 daily series. The stored thresholds and winter-event totals are legacy prototype values; raw daily data, exact river-point match and independent calculations are not supplied.
metadata.refresh_note: Do not run the legacy refresh routine for 2016-2025. Select the correct OPW daily discharge station for each town, verify at least ten full years of daily mean discharge and quality codes, calculate Q95/Q99 using a stated method, count separate winter runs at or above Q99, and replace the provisional statistics.
metadata.opw_station_crosscheck_source: https://waterlevel.ie/list/ (OPW hydrometric station list; station identifiers and listed waterbodies)
metadata.opw_station_crosscheck_status: Station candidates for all eight towns were identified in the OPW station list. Daily discharge archive coverage, point coordinates and completeness for a full ten-year period have NOT been verified.
metadata.town_station_candidates: Ennis candidate uses OPW station 27023 Victoria Bridge on the Fergus, rather than the Ennis Bridge Fergus Estuary station; this is a candidate only, not a validated daily discharge series.
metadata.warning: The legacy 3,653-day 2016-2025 claim is unsupported by GloFAS v4 reanalysis, which ends July 2022. OPW gauge candidates are not proof that a ten-year daily archive was downloaded or checked.
